static_traits.name: Jiang Kevin
static_traits.family_status: Mother is a Nurse; the rest Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of supportive friends and colleagues who understand the challenges of the music profession, but after audition failures tends toward self-isolation and finds it hard to open up to others about the predicament
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received psychotherapy before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent logic; able to self-Reflection; emotions mainly Anxiety and Self-doubt; cooperation Good; tending to emphasize the negative and negate positive feedback

basic_info.main_problem: Performing poorly in auditions, never being hired despite professional training; strong Anxiety appears with every audition opportunity (like hand trembling, mind going blank), Self-doubt and focusing on negative feedback.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeking counseling because this sense of inadequacy blocks my Career development as a violinist, I want to resolve them.
growth_experiences: Since starting to participate in professional auditions, repeatedly not yet hired and showing marked physiological and cognitive reactions in auditions (hand trembling, mind going blank); after auditions only remembering negative feedback, negating positive evaluations, gradually Reinforcing the view 'I am not good enough, will never be hired', causing Persistent self-doubt and Anxiety; sleep disrupted accordingly, and choosing to isolate from friends and colleagues after failures.

core_beliefs: No matter how hard I try I will not be hired / I am destined to fail

special_situations.event: Receiving an audition notice or approaching audition day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If any mistake or imperfection occurs in the audition, it proves I am not good enough and will Be rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling practice, repeatedly rehearsing and trying to control Anxiety with forced positive self-suggestion; avoiding discussing auditions with others to reduce being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up again this time, I still will not be hired

special_situations.event: After the audition, receives mixed feedback with both praise and criticism
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative opinions are more real than positive feedback and better represent overall ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focusing only on negative evaluations, negating or ignoring positive praise, thinking this better promotes improvement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That criticism shows I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Recalling the experience of multiple past auditions not yet being hired
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Past failures predict inevitable future failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Wavering about career choices, reduces interaction with peers to avoid being frustrated again

special_situations.event: Social situations with colleagues or friends after unsuccessful auditions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose vulnerability or talk about failure, I will be seen as weak and incompetent; Others' evaluations determine my worth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-isolates and avoids talking about audition results to avoid being looked down on
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am weak / a failure

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, to prove one's worth before authoritative reviewers and peers and gain a professional position
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected and being judged as incompetent, accompanied by strong shame and loss of control
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of control by negating positive feedback and emphasizing inadequacies, avoiding the pain of dashed hopes
Reduces the possibility of judgment and shame through isolation and avoiding exposing vulnerability

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough failure / a performer who may err at any time
object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges or peers/authorities who may look down on him

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes one's strengths or positive feedback and invites seeing strengths and progress at the same time
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Acknowledging the positive equals ignoring problems and will be seen as complacency, making failure more likely again
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Calm and rational tone, repeatedly emphasizing 'should focus on inadequacies' 'the negative matters more', using factual and rule-like statements to dilute emotional experience, avoiding detailed exploration of shame and vulnerability.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores feelings after failure or suggests seeking support from peers and sharing difficulties
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Expressing vulnerability will be seen by others as weak or incompetent, inviting more judgment instead
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using self-blaming language (like 'it is all because I am not good enough'), lowering speech rate, reducing eye contact, quickly turning the topic back to personal inadequacies and the self-improvement checklist, avoiding exploring others' reactions and own need for support.

manifestations: Tending to self-isolate after each unsuccessful audition, unwilling to communicate with friends and colleagues
Hard to open up to the supportive network about audition difficulties, worries about being seen as weak
outcomes: Reduced social support, worsened shame and Anxiety

manifestations: Questioning own career choice after repeatedly not yet being hired
Ignoring progress and strengths by focusing only on negative feedback, feeling efforts 'have no meaning'
outcomes: Persistent Sleep disturbance and performance Anxiety

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Holding the belief 'only focusing on shortcomings / negative feedback counts as responsible', negating praise
Evaluating self with strict standards, hard to accept imperfection

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently self-evaluating with 'I am not good enough' 'I will fail', cautiously avoiding exposing vulnerability
Worrying about being seen as weak by others, thus unwilling to seek help from supporters

positive_force: Love for music and long-term professional training
Continuously practices at high frequency and takes supplementary course learning, proactively expands the music community network
Has supportive friends and colleagues who understand industry challenges
negative_force: Cognitive biases like catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mental filtering, and negating positive feedback maintaining Self-doubt
Strong Fear of rejection and being judged triggering performance Anxiety and reactions like hand trembling, distraction
After failure, self-isolates and finds it hard to seek help, weakening social support
Sleep disturbance and rumination worsening Anxiety and functional impairment

target_behavior.behavior: Strong performance Anxiety in audition situations (hand trembling, mind going blank)
antecedent: Receiving an audition notice or nearing audition day
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic predictions of Being rejected and failure and high sensitivity to negative evaluation, forming conditioned Anxiety reactions
target_behavior.function: In the short term, tries to escape failure and shame and gain a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired on-the-spot performance, increased experiences of not yet being hired, further Reinforcing Self-doubt and Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Self-isolation and Avoids socializing after unsuccessful auditions
antecedent: After not yet being hired in auditions
Being asked about audition results by friends or colleagues
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being seen as weak or incompetent, shame-driven avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoids the negative emotions of being judged and set back again
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged relationships, Reduced social support, maintained negative emotions and Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: Negating positive evaluations and focusing on negative opinions in feedback situations
antecedent: Receives mixed (both positive and negative) feedback after an audition
target_behavior.core_reason: Introjected harsh standards and personalized Interpretation, giving negative information higher weight
target_behavior.function: Maintaining improvement motivation and sense of control by emphasizing inadequacies, avoiding the disappointment of 'dashed hopes'
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Anxiety and Reinforcement of inadequacy, Decreased professional confidence
